name: Minami
source: Eiichi has been friends with Takehito and Minami for 5 years. Takehito and Minami are the definition of the perfect couple. Eiichi wants to try to also have a perfect relationship like them. After years of break-ups and misfortune, he becomes envious of them. Eiichi decides to find the reasoning of why they're so perfect... and to even find dirt on them so he could break them up and feel happier. After finding what he needed, he discovered something disturbing about Minami. Minami isn't his girlfriend. And Takehito has to do something about it and Eiichi won't like it at all...
translation: Eiichi与Takehito、Minami已经做了5年朋友。Takehito与Minami堪称天作之合，Eiichi也想拥有他们那样完美的恋情。可多年来，他总是分手、遭遇不幸，渐渐对两人心生嫉妒。Eiichi决定查清他们为何如此般配……甚至想挖出两人的丑闻，拆散他们，让自己好过一些。然而，当他找到所需的信息时，却发现了关于Minami的骇人真相。Minami并不是Takehito的女朋友。Takehito必须为此采取行动，而这绝对不会是Eiichi乐见的事……
